//==
// ## Bounding volume hierarchies

// One node of a 2D bounding volume hierarchy. Internal nodes carry child
// node indices and an empty Primitives range; leaves carry LeftChild and
// RightChild of -1 and a non-empty half-open range into the owning
// hierarchy's PrimitiveIndices.
type BvhNode2D
    implements IValue
{
    Bounds: Bounds2D;
    LeftChild: SpatialNodeIndex;
    RightChild: SpatialNodeIndex;
    Primitives: IntegerInterval;
}
